# ChefYoyo

> > ChefYoyo is a home cooking resource featuring detailed recipes for weeknight dinners, meal prep, and beginner-friendly dishes with techniques from bistro cooking to Mediterranean cuisine.

The site focuses on approachable recipes that balance flavor and convenience, featuring everything from 30-minute meals to special occasion dishes. Recipes emphasize quality ingredients like Gruyère, Atlantic salmon, and homemade seasonings, with clear instructions for home cooks of all skill levels.
